adme.distribution: Highly protein-bound (>99%), distributes into synovial fluid.
adme.metabolism: Metabolized extensively in the liver via CYP2C9 to inactive metabolites.
adme.excretion: Excreted rapidly via kidneys as metabolites and conjugates.

sideEffects.renal: Acute kidney injury due to afferent arteriole vasoconstriction
sideEffects.cardiovascular: Fluid retention and increased blood pressure
